x-aisa-source.refresh_reason: Regenerate from the refreshed official document; the route binding is rechecked against Runtime digests.

entityId.description: Live organization entity identifier; falls back to `liveOrganizationId`, which LinkedIn uses as the entity ID.

slug.description: Public organization slug; falls back to the `/company/` segment of `url`.

followerCount.description: Follower count; filled from `followerCountLabel` when that is an exact number.

followerCountLabel.description: Follower count label when the source supplies shorthand text.

logoUrl.description: Primary logo URL; falls back to the first `logos` entry.

hasMore.description: Null when continuation is unknown for this page.

reportedTotal.description: Total reported for this page of results; not a guarantee of globally retrievable matches.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.
